purpose: Curated list of date-interval templates tied to real historical anchors (imperial reigns, dynasties, datable events). Per Decision 38 (historical-anchor principle) these carry genuine evidential signal ('Flavian' means something that 'second half of the first century' does not) and are therefore classified genuine-but-aoristic, NOT editorial convention. The list is used to (a) strip width-accidental reign/event leaks from the F1+F3 convention pool so the convention/genuine split is non-width-accidental, and (b) define the genuine-but-aoristic class for reporting.
scope_note: Under the Decision 38 / Option-2 basis (fine brackets EXCLUDED from primary convention), the only empirical leaks ([161,180] and [161,200]) both fall in the fine-bracket widths (19, 39) that are already excluded from the primary p_conv. Hence this list's NUMERICAL role is confined to the add-the-fine-brackets-back SENSITIVITY variant: when fine brackets are moved into convention for the robustness band, anchor-matching intervals are first stripped so the sensitivity test adds only genuine calendar windows, not reign-anchored ranges. The 5 core slabs (widths 49/99/149/199/299) are anchor-clean by construction (zero canonical-reign matches at those widths under 25-year alignment; verified 2026-06-06).

match_rule.rule: An inscription template [not_before, not_after] matches an anchor [lo, hi] iff |not_before - lo| <= tol AND |not_after - hi| <= tol.
match_rule.applies_to: F1_round and F3_periodic inscriptions (the convention pool). Matched inscriptions are reclassified to genuine-but-aoristic.
match_rule.tolerance_rationale: Conventional accession/death years vary by a year across sources; +/-1 matches the family-classifier's round_aligned convention (scan_templates.py REIGN_TOL).

empirical_leak_measured_2026_06_06.corpus: prereg-filtered empire frame, 180,609 rows; F1+F3 pool = 117,768
empirical_leak_measured_2026_06_06.note: Only [161,180] matches a canonical anchor within the F1+F3 pool. It is a 20-year window (fine bracket) -> already excluded from primary convention under Option 2. [161,200] (40-y window) is anchored on Marcus's accession but is not a clean reign interval; it is likewise a fine bracket and excluded from primary convention. Source: runs/2026-06-06-convention-basis-redesign/outputs/tables/anchor-leak.csv.

events_policy.rationale: Datable historical events (a colony's foundation, a war, a specific consulship, a building dedication) in epigraphic practice almost always produce YEAR-PRECISE [t, t] dates or odd-width ranges, which the family classifier already places in Tight (<=4 y) or F2_Other -> already genuine. No clean event interval coincides with an F1 calendar-slab width under 25-year alignment. Hence events require no explicit interval entries to be correctly classified genuine; they are covered by the Tight/F2_Other families. This policy is documented so a reviewer sees events were considered, not omitted.
